metadata.name: rabbitmq
metadata.description: RabbitMQ integration family. Concrete providers (rabbitmq, rabbitmq-kubernetes, rabbitmq-topology) implement subsets of these operations and declare it via IntegrationType.implemented_operations.

spec.description: Contract for any provider that adapts RabbitMQ for Yggdrasil — covers Management API operations (ensure_*), declarative topology, and Kubernetes installation.

operations.name: ensure_vhost
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one virtual host exists with the desired metadata.

operations.name: ensure_user
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one user exists with the desired tags and password.

operations.name: ensure_permissions
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one user permission set exists for a virtual host.

operations.name: ensure_queue
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one queue exists with the desired arguments.

operations.name: ensure_exchange
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one exchange exists with the desired type and properties.

operations.name: ensure_binding
operations.description: Idempotently ensure one binding exists between an exchange and its destination.

operations.name: apply_topology_spec
operations.description: Apply a declarative topology spec (vhosts, users, permissions, queues, exchanges, bindings) idempotently. Non-destructive unless input.purge_removed=true.

operations.name: describe_topology
operations.description: Return the currently observed topology of a virtual host (queues, exchanges, bindings) for diff against a spec.

operations.name: generate_installation
operations.description: Materialize a RabbitMQ broker installation as raw Kubernetes objects.

operations.name: reconcile_installation
operations.description: Build a declarative reconciliation plan for a RabbitMQ broker installation.

operations.name: discover_installation_state
operations.description: Return the currently known installation state for a RabbitMQ broker blueprint.
